verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud platform with an SDK and CLI, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The OpenTelemetry export and logs/metrics features cover observability of the user's own workloads, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
